column1: # Accepted benchmark values for the micro and gate batteries.
# `battery check` compares `<cell>:median` rows only and fails when a
# reported median is neither within 50% of the recorded baseline nor
# within an absolute floor in the metric's own unit (100 ms, 0.1 s,
# 100000 us, 1 MB). Anything else, including a missing or `n/a` value,
# fails. Repeat rows are recorded but never checked, so baselines use
# Long format, one row per cell+metric.
#   cell      battery cell id: <level>-<profile> or its `:median`
#   baseline  accepted value, in the report's unit
#   recorded  date or commit the value was recorded on
#   note      why this row exists in this form
# `# env:` lines record one JSON object per battery run that produced the
# medians above (host, kernel, CPU, governor, memory, load, git identity).
# Same run replaces, other runs carry over — like the metric rows.
